name: Elemental War

angles.text: Shamans revere the balance of the elements, making this direct conflict between Neptulon's servants and fire elementals a vivid demonstration of primal elemental strife.
Given that Tsunaman is stationed at Sun Rock Retreat, Horde adventurers passing through Stonetalon Mountains are directly positioned to assist in this elemental clash.

faq.answer: Tsunaman is an emissary sent by the Tribunal of the Tides to Sun Rock Retreat in Stonetalon Mountains. Acting under the authority of Neptulon the Tidehunter, he seeks to wage war on fire elementals and recruits adventurers to help destroy them.

Neptulon the Tidehunter, the Elemental Lord of water, holds an ancient enmity against fire elementals and has taken a personal interest in extinguishing them. Tsunaman was dispatched by the Tribunal of the Tides to carry out this campaign in Stonetalon Mountains.
faq.q: Why does Neptulon want the fire elementals destroyed?

faq.answer: The Charred Vale is a devastated, ash-covered basin located in southern Stonetalon Mountains. It is overrun by fiery elemental creatures and other dangerous beasts born of flame and ruin.
faq.q: Where is the Charred Vale located?

faq.answer: Incendrites are burning remnants left behind when the fire elementals of the Charred Vale are extinguished. Tsunaman collects these cores as physical proof of their destruction to build favor with the Tribunal of the Tides.

The Tribunal of the Tides is an authority among water elementals serving Neptulon the Tidehunter. They direct elemental forces and envoys like Tsunaman to advance the Tidehunter's will against rival elemental domains.
faq.q: What is the Tribunal of the Tides?

faq.answer: Neptulon the Tidehunter is the Elemental Lord of water, ruling over the oceans, seas, and all water elementals. Like the other elemental lords, he wages an ancient, perpetual conflict against rival elements, especially fire.

sections.body: In the rugged reaches of Stonetalon Mountains, an envoy named Tsunaman has arrived at Sun Rock Retreat on behalf of the Tribunal of the Tides. Acting under the supreme will of Neptulon the Tidehunter, the lord of water elementals, Tsunaman seeks to carry out an ancient vendetta against their fiery kin. Rather than a dispute over mortal borders, this conflict represents the unending clash of Azeroth's primal forces.
sections.title: Primal Rivalry in the Mountains

sections.body: The primary battleground for this struggle is the Charred Vale, a scarred wasteland smoldering in southern Stonetalon Mountains. Fire elementals thrive amidst the ashes, threatening the surrounding regions. Adventurers are enlisted to descend into the vale, snuff out these flame-wreathed entities, and gather Incendrites—blazing remnants left behind upon an elemental's defeat—to prove their destruction to the Tribunal.
sections.title: The Ash and the Flame

summary: Elemental War is a task undertaken for Tsunaman, an envoy of the water elementals residing at Sun Rock Retreat in Stonetalon Mountains. Guided by the will of Neptulon the Tidehunter, adventurers are sent into the scorched depths of the Charred Vale to extinguish blazing fire elementals and collect their smoldering Incendrite cores. It provides a rare glimpse into the ancient, perpetual rivalry that divides the elemental planes.
